problem_restatement.observed: The active external-asset digest described MU as source-native observation after the failed transport-parity window, even though a later immutable source-native lifecycle result had already rejected the frozen family.
problem_restatement.required_state: The digest must preserve the failed transport prerequisite and also surface the latest terminal source-native lifecycle disposition.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: The default catalog binds both immutable results and the running monitor reports stage source_native_lifecycle_rejected_v1 with no live authority.

root_cause.finding: The prior catalog correction stopped at the V2 transport-parity result and did not append the subsequently published source-native lifecycle journal artifact.
root_cause.boundary: The hypothesis override ledger already contained the source-native rejection; only the external-asset catalog and generated digest lagged it.
root_cause.failure_mode: A correct terminal research decision could remain hidden behind an older technical-failure stage, making rejected work look unresolved and inviting duplicate replay or post-hoc retuning.

source_native_result.interpretation: The result rejects live addition of this frozen family. Five resolved paths are too sparse to estimate stable expectancy, and the fifteen censored paths could update the magnitude or sign in a genuinely independent complete window.

validation.red_test: The default-catalog regression failed because it observed prospective_shadow_source_native_after_parity_rejection_v2 instead of source_native_lifecycle_rejected_v1.
validation.green_test: The same targeted regression passed after the exact catalog correction.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The immutable replay has five resolved lifecycles, so economic confidence remains limited despite the negative point estimate.
Fifteen censored paths prevent a complete-window claim and could materially update the result in either direction.
The still-running observer has 21 eligible decisions, one more than the frozen report, but no new immutable complete-lifecycle result was generated in this correction.
A future independent window is not comparable if entry, exit, source, cost, or path-admission rules change after observing outcomes.
falsifier: This correction is falsified if the catalog no longer binds the recorded source-native artifact bytes, the generated digest does not report source_native_lifecycle_rejected_v1, or an independent preregistered source-native window resolves complete both-side lifecycles and remains positive after exact costs, stress, and largest-winner removal under an unchanged contract.

next_investigation.1_recommendation: Keep MU report-only and do not retune or promote the rejected family. Continue the already-ranked HYPE exact both-side live-lifecycle collection as the single highest-value investigation.
next_investigation.2_why_now: MU now has a terminal negative source-native result, while HYPE is funded, active, and still lacks any attributable eligible lifecycle under its frozen V57 alignment contract.
next_investigation.3_evidence_reviewed: MU observer status, 20-onset immutable lifecycle replay, exact mark/book/funding/fee provenance, V2 parity failure, hypothesis overrides, external catalog, generated digest, and fresh V57 checkpoint.
next_investigation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: The main uncertainty is no longer MU transport; it is whether the active HYPE contract ever produces both-side eligible lifecycles with acceptable after-cost outcomes.
next_investigation.5_applicable_market_regime: HYPE fresh breakout-onset after compression and pullback, aligned with breakout direction, under the frozen V57 both-side contract.
next_investigation.6_alternatives_considered: Rerun MU parity, retune MU after losses, relax HYPE gates, or collect exact HYPE lifecycles unchanged. The first three reuse rejected or post-hoc paths; unchanged collection preserves causal evidence.
next_investigation.8_expected_upside: Obtain attributable evidence for the active funded route without adding exposure or contaminating the hypothesis with post-outcome changes.
next_investigation.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse cadence, one-sided events, regime concentration, winner dependence, source gaps, stale entry or exit evidence, and false confidence from a small sample.
next_investigation.10_validation_completed: MU terminal result reconciliation, source-bound catalog correction, automated regression, live monitor reload, and live-runtime isolation check.
next_investigation.11_validation_still_required: At least one technically resolved eligible HYPE lifecycle per configured side to update diagnosis, followed by a preregistered compatible window with exact fees, funding, slippage, stop behavior, gaps, and largest-winner sensitivity before proposing change.
next_investigation.12_success_metrics: Exact route and profile attribution, complete lifecycle evidence, both sides represented, positive after-cost stress result without the largest winner, and no source or timing mismatch.
next_investigation.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: No rollback is needed because no live change is proposed. Stop or repair only the report-only collector if identity, source completeness, freshness, or evidence hashes fail.
next_investigation.14_confidence_level: High confidence in the lineage correction and MU arithmetic; low confidence in stable MU expectancy because only five lifecycles resolved; high confidence that unchanged HYPE collection is the highest-value current diagnostic.
